title: Love it!
text: Love it!. This is one of the silliest things I've ever seen!  It makes me smile when I look at it, and it's a great addition to my large collection of mice, which I've been accumulating for over 50 years! (Yikes!)

product_metadata.title: Ebros Dupers Collection Mouse Rat Disguising As A Tabby Cat Statue 5.25" Tall Crafty Mice in Kitty Kitten Cats Costume Decor Figurine Collectible
features: This Rat In Tabby Cat's Clothing Dupers Collections Statue is 5.25" tall, 2.5" long and 2" deep approximately. The sculpture weighs about 7 ounces.
This Rat In Tabby Cat's Clothing Dupers Collections Statue is made of designer composite resin, hand painted and polished. Color Tone may vary.

This sneaky rat mouse hides from plain sight within a cat's costume. With such an effective disguise, it can be placed among other cat collectibles undetected. Perhaps with this disguise, all rats can have their cheeses without being meals themselves!
